title: HOLD ALT FOR THE RAID STATUS
why: His order of 2026-10-13: hold Alt for the raid status (not Tab). While Alt is held a plate in the look of the other HUD panels (graphite, the amber tick, the cut corner, the HUD condensed caps) shows, upper centre so the middle of the screen stays clear: the CURRENT PILLAGERS board as it is ranked (the first eight, you first, each with what they carry; a living pillager reads OUT HERE whatever he is doing, as the board has said since v8.08, and only EXTRACTED and DEAD are outcomes), your score and credits (CAREER SCORE in a career raid, the DEMO score with the team split in the arcade, the haul in a plain raid), the raid clock (red in the last minute), the extraction (the state of the ring that was called, and the nearest open one with its distance and direction), and your teammate in co-op (health and armour, DOWN with the count, EXTRACTED, DEAD or left). It goes the moment Alt is let go, and stays off while the map, the backpack or a stall is up. Alt is the browser menu key, so in a raid its press and release are claimed and the page never takes the focus; so are the keys pressed while it is held (Alt and D would otherwise jump to the address bar). The key is on the rebind list as RAID STATUS (HOLD), default Alt, and the full controls list names it. A party member now remembers how a teammate left the raid (extracted or dead) so the status can say it.
now: Hold Alt to see the raid status: the pillagers board, your score and credits, the raid clock, the extraction and your teammate.
